name: Cost and Affordability of a Healthy Diet: Cost and Affordability of a Healthy Diet (CoAHD)
topic: The dataset contains indicators relative to the cost of a healty diet, the cost disaggregated by the six major food groups, the prevalence of unaffordability and the number of people unable to afford a healthy diet. Data is provided at the national, regional and global level, as well as by income groups classification.

topic: Consumer Price Index (CPI) of Food and Non-Alcoholic beverages and of all-items. The CPI dataset is published at the country, subregional, regional and income group levels.

name: Macro-Economic Indicators: Capital Stock
topic: Capital stock in the agricultural sector covers data on domestic Gross Fixed Capital Formation (GFCF), Consumption of Fix Capital (CFC), Net Capital Stock (NCS) in the Agricultural sector and derived indicators, including Agricultural Investment Ratio (AIR) and Agricultural Orientation Index for GFCF (AOI), from 1995 to 2023. The dataset covers 195 countries.

name: Investment: Development Flows to Agriculture
topic: The DFA dataset provides broad geographical and institutional coverage, including recipient countries, regions and subregions, and development-finance flows reported by bilateral, multilateral and private providers. Development finance is disseminated under four main flow categories: ODA, OOF, PG, and PSI. (PSI is included in DFA from 2023 onwards.) The dataset covers Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing (AFF) and its components, together with additional analytical areas relevant to agrifood systems, including Rural Development, Agro-industry, and General Environment Protection. Information is provided for both commitments and disbursements.

topic: The dataset provides indicators for eight surveys from five countries. Depending on the dataset, the whole population is disaggregated by age, sex, area type and geographical level. In addition, depending on the survey, specific population groups in terms of age and sex can be covered.

name: Food and Diet: Apparent intake (based on household consumption and expenditure surveys)
topic: The population groups covered are those represented in each survey. Usually, household consumption and expenditure surveys have representativeness at national level, and/or urban-rural areas, and/or regions, province, district, etc. If the microdata include information on income or proxy of income (e.g., total consumption expenditures) aggregated at the household level, statistics are also provided by income quintile groups at the national level.

Investment: Credit to Agriculture
topic: Total credit which is the account of credit to all economy / credit to agriculture, forestry and fishing which is the amount of credit to agriculture, forestry and fishing sector (ISIC Rev. 4, A_01-03) / credit to agriculture as a breakdown of agriculture, forestry and fishing sector (ISIC Rev. 4, A_01-03) / credit to forestry as a breakdown of agriculture, forestry and fishing sector (ISIC Rev. 4, A_01-03) / credit to fishing as a breakdown of agriculture, forestry and fishing sector (ISIC Rev. 4, A_01-03). Data on credit to agriculture is available for 131 countries and territories, while data on total credit is available for 177 countries and territories, according to the FAO Standard on Country or Area Codes for Statistical Use.

topic: The Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and the Gross Fixed Capital Formation (GFCF) of the total economy, value added of agriculture, forestry and fishing activity, value added of total manufacturing activity, value added of manufacturing activitiy of food and beverages products, value added of manufacturing activitiy of tobacco products, value added of manufacturing activity of food, beverages and tobacco products, gross output of agriculture activity, gross output of agriculture, forestry and fishing activity, value added of agriculture activity, and the Gross National Income (GNI). The macroeconomic indicators dataset is published at contries level and at regional and sub-regional levels.

name: Production: Production Indices
topic: The FAO indices of agricultural production show the relative level of the aggregate volume of agricultural production for each year in comparison with the base period 2014-2016. They are based on the sum of price-weighted quantities of different agricultural commodities produced after deductions of quantities used as seed and feed weighted in a similar manner. The resulting aggregate represents, therefore, disposable production for any use except as seed and feed.

name: Production: Value of Agricultural Production

name: World Census of Agriculture: Structural data from agricultural censuses
topic: This domain provides access to structural data from censuses of agriculture conducted by FAO member countries and territories during various WCA rounds (WCA 1930, 1950, 1960, 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020). Disseminated indicators include the number and area of holdings by land size classes; number of parcels and average number of parcels per holding; sex of agricultural holders; holders by age group and sex, holdings by number of parcels, holdings by household size; number and area of holdings by land tenure types; number and area of holdings by legal status of the holder; demography of farms and source of farm labour. The domain also includes the number of holdings, total area of holdings and average area of holdings. Data are aggregated at the national level.
